observability_triage.rationale: The requirement is a comparison between the physical pin numbering of a power-board connector and a main-board connector. The frozen build emits only one design.kicad_sch/design.kicad_pcb pair and its synthetic interboard component does not identify two board-owned connector instances, so equal ordering cannot be observed independently.
repair_requirements: Build separate power-board and main-board KiCad artifacts, or encode immutable board ownership for both connector instances.
Expose each four-pin JST-PH connector's physical pad number to net mapping in parsed build output.

evidence: Only one schematic and PCB are declared as stable artifacts.
The pre-repo contains one aggregate interboard component rather than separately addressable main-board and power-board connectors.
No board ownership field is serialized into the KiCad output.
minimum_environment_repairs: Emit and parse two board artifacts or an equivalent board-scoped design package.
Add stable connector references and board ownership to the artifact contract.
blocker_or_exclusion.reentry_condition: Re-author criteria when both board connector instances can be selected independently and their physical pad-to-net maps compared.

uncovered_items.evidence: The single-board output cannot distinguish or compare the two required physical connectors.
uncovered_items.required_action: Repair the board-scoped build surface before validator authoring.
